items.text: OUT-001 retains two bounded delegations and one human decision, with complete briefs and a connected file graph, return queue and exact-act decision package; actual child execution is supported independently of brief existence. Verify by VER-001. Source: REQ-001, CLM-001, S2/S3.

verification.text: On the identified candidate, observe the two brief-bound delegations through native child identities/events, graph, return queue and one exact-act decision package; compare each brief with required fields and link actual launches/returns rather than infer them from authored records. Produces OUT-001 fixture evidence for AC-001.

items.text: OUT-001 includes every longer-work condition in REQ-002 and permits observation of the corresponding state distinctions through the change of basis and interruption, including a still-active worker and a return awaiting review. Verify by VER-002. Source: S1/S2/S4.

verification.text: Exercise the fixture's dependent/ready work, outstanding review, actual worker ownership, changed basis and interruption of review/integration; observe before/interruption/resumption states and retain active, returned, reviewed, integrated and waiting distinctions. Produces OUT-001 evidence for AC-002; no elapsed-time or staffing threshold is imposed.

items.text: OUT-002 reconstructs file-derived cross-session views with actual ownership, prerequisites, results, next work, waiting causes, independent findings, reviewed/integrated history and pending decisions intact; missing observations remain unknown. Verify by VER-003. Source: REQ-002/REQ-003, S3/S4.

verification.text: Rebuild the coordination views across sessions from the source files, correlate live worker observations, and compare reconstructed state with the retained evidence. Check every REQ-002/REQ-003 distinction, including pending choices and unknown outcomes. Produces OUT-002 reconstruction evidence for AC-003.

items.text: OUT-002 preserves a faithfully recorded performed human decision with decision actor distinct from recorder, and rejects unsupported attribution from tool success, silence, timeout or another act; other independently evidenced acts retain their own standing. Verify by VER-004. Source: REQ-004, CLM-002, S2/S3.

verification.text: Compare the observed human decision and its bound subject against the record, confirming distinct actor/recorder attribution. Examine unsupported success/silence/timeout-derived attribution and confirm it cannot invent a human act; inspect separately evidenced execution/checking/acceptance/approval/reliance without imposing an unstated sequence. Produces OUT-002 attribution evidence for AC-004 under the actual adopted policy.

items.text: OUT-002 links candidate/configuration/date, actual workers and returns, supplied basis, independent findings, observed outcomes and limits, including affected checks reopened after a candidate/basis change without weakening their criteria. Verify by VER-005. Source: REQ-005, S1/S4/S5.

verification.text: Independently examine result identity and standing, worker/return provenance and enforcement descriptions, the changed-basis history and affected-check reopening. Trace findings to the actual candidate and ensure criterion protection. Produces OUT-002 evidence for AC-005; absent product inputs are blocked/not run/inconclusive as warranted, not an executed pass or failure.

items.text: OUT-002 identifies the separate joined evidence added beyond a first-host slice, conversation recovery, file-native practice and component checks; none alone is presented as fulfilled longer-work coverage, practitioner validation or replacement approval. Verify by VER-006. Source: REQ-005/REQ-006, CLM-003, S2/S4/S5.

verification.text: Compare the joined evidence coverage with the bounded first-host, conversation-only and component evidence; identify what this witness actually adds and remaining limits. Check that it makes no unsupported validation or replacement decision claim. Produces OUT-002 coverage evidence for AC-006.

items.text: Both outputs preserve named contribution owners and unresolved choices at their actual points of need, without adding fleet features, assigning external construction, inventing policy, or equating definition maturity with required input availability. Verify by VER-007. Source: REQ-006, S1/S3/S6/S7.

verification.text: Review both outputs against S1/S6 contribution ownership, REQ-006 and the open matters below, confirming local scope and conditional points of need. Produces the ownership/open-input account for AC-007 without deciding those matters.
